path.description: A Declared Input path, exactly as the Harness gave it. A relative path is resolved from the working directory.

output.description: The new frame Handle and the frame's shape. ``result.get(name)`` finds one column.

warnings.description: Caveats on this result, most actionable first. Empty when there are none.

items.description: A caveat on a successful result: it worked, but read this first.

code.description: The warning's Error Code. Branch on this, not on ``message``.

message.description: What happened and what to do, in one or two sentences.

columns.description: Columns the warning concerns, or null.

param.description: The argument the warning concerns, or null.

omitted.description: One entry per list that was cut, naming the Operation that returns the rest. Empty when nothing was cut.

items.description: A capped list was cut. Call ``operation`` to read the rest.

field.description: Name of the list field that was cut.

shown.description: How many items the list holds.

operation.description: The Operation that returns the rest, or null when no Operation does.

frame.description: Frame Handle for the loaded data, such as ``frame_7f3a9c2e``.

n_rows.description: Number of data rows, not counting the header.

n_columns.description: Number of columns, including any not listed in ``columns``.

columns.description: Columns in CSV header order, at most 100. Past 100, ``omitted`` counts the rest.

items.description: One column of the loaded frame.

column.description: Column name, exactly as in the CSV header.

dtype.description: Type the CSV reader inferred, such as ``Int64``, ``Float64`` or ``String``.
